findings.repro: Open a venture you're a member of on a phone.
findings.fix: Wrap or move secondary tabs into a 'More' menu.

findings.what: After a decline you can apply again to the same role straight away; duplicate applications pile up in Requests.
findings.fix: Say 'Ali declined this on 24 Nov' and allow reapplying after a set time.

findings.what: 'Apply to join' is shown on a full venture (2 of 2, role Filled).
findings.fix: Replace with 'Team full · Follow for updates'.

findings.what: Separate Save buttons per section and no unsaved warning; leaving after an edit silently drops it.
findings.fix: Warn on leave, or autosave with 'Saved'.

findings.what: On an empty-title error focus stays on the button.
findings.fix: Move focus to the first invalid field.

findings.what: Accept and Decline act instantly with no confirmation, no reason and no toast.
findings.fix: Confirm Decline with an optional reason; toast with Undo.

findings.what: Posting an update, linking a repository and adding a deliverable show no confirmation.
findings.fix: 'Posted.' / 'Saved.' toasts as elsewhere.

findings.what: After an entry is corrected, a teammate can't confirm the correction ('confirm the entry, not a correction').
findings.repro: Correct your entry, ask a teammate to confirm.
findings.fix: Let teammates confirm the current version.

findings.what: Abandoned ventures are listed first under 'Any status' and on profiles.
findings.fix: Hide abandoned by default; show them under a filter.

findings.what: Confirming a teammate's entry is instant with no dialog, though it can't be undone and affects their score.
findings.fix: Confirm: 'You confirm Ali did this. This can't be undone.'

findings.what: Until a new student finishes or skips the tour, opening any page (Settings, Me, a notification or shared link) redirects to /feed to show tour step 1.
findings.repro: Sign up, leave the welcome screen without choosing, open /settings/privacy.
findings.fix: Start the tour only on /feed, and only by choice; never redirect a deep link.

findings.what: The email typed on Sign in isn't carried to Reset password.
findings.fix: Prefill the email.

findings.what: An updated agreement can only be accepted; no link to decline, export or delete the account.
findings.repro: Publish a new version, sign in.
findings.fix: Add 'Don't agree? Delete your account' with what happens.

findings.what: Lists Recruiter contact requests, Job applications and Recruiting while the recruiter portal is off; 19 autosave toasts when changing many.
findings.fix: Hide portal categories while portals are off; one 'Saved' toast.

findings.what: Leaving with unsaved changes drops them silently ('Unsaved changes' shows but there's no warning).
findings.fix: Warn before leaving with unsaved changes.

findings.what: The leaderboard switch has no accessible name.
findings.repro: Focus the switch with a screen reader.
findings.fix: aria-labelledby the 'Show me on leaderboards' label.

findings.what: Devices are a recent-activity log, and 'Sign out of all devices' includes this one; you can't sign out the others only.
findings.fix: List active sessions with 'This device', and 'Sign out other devices'.

findings.what: Too-big files are only rejected after Send, and the same certificate can be submitted again and again.
findings.repro: Choose a 6 MB PDF; send one twice.
findings.fix: Check size on choosing; warn on duplicates.

findings.what: Nothing says what happens when the beta ends.
findings.fix: One line on the beta and its end date.

findings.what: The form attaches '/feedback' as the page, not the page the student came from; the phone account menu has no Feedback link.
findings.repro: Open Feedback from the score page.
findings.fix: Pass ?from= and show it.

findings.what: Level rules switch to third person ('a repository they own') while the advice says 'you'.
findings.fix: Use 'you' throughout.

findings.what: Switching a repository off immediately removes every skill it proved (here all L2 skills), with no confirmation or explanation.
findings.fix: Confirm with 'JavaScript and SQL drop to L1 or disappear'; show the effect.

findings.what: Returning from GitHub without installing says 'That GitHub link expired or was opened in another account.'
findings.fix: 'You didn't finish on GitHub. Connect again when you're ready.'

findings.what: With 2 paths followed, other paths' Follow button disappears without explanation.
findings.repro: Follow two paths, look at a third.
findings.fix: Show Follow disabled with 'Unfollow one first (2 max)'.

findings.what: 'Verifying with GitHub' gives no expected time or what happens if nothing is found.
findings.fix: 'Usually within an hour; if your commits don't show it, a peer checks it.'

findings.what: The review page names the repository but doesn't link to it or say what 'checking' means (run, read).
findings.fix: Link the repository and the commits since the task started; one line on how to check.

findings.what: The swap request was sent with empty preferred times and no error, though the form asks for times.
findings.repro: Send a request leaving Times empty.
findings.fix: Require at least one time, or say it's optional.

findings.what: End swap uses the browser's native confirm; the Taught entry reads 'Taught: Taught SQL to Ayesha'.
findings.fix: Use the app's dialog; title 'Taught SQL to Ayesha'.

findings.what: After revoking a share link, the page keeps showing the revoked URL with 'Copy link'; Revoke has no confirmation.
findings.fix: Clear the one-time link panel on revoke; confirm the revoke.

findings.what: The empty Record suggests an event whose registration has closed.
findings.repro: Open the Record with no entries.
findings.fix: Suggest only events open for registration.

findings.what: The section show/hide switches have no accessible name.
findings.repro: Focus a section switch with a screen reader.
findings.fix: Label each with the section name.

findings.what: The PDF check is only on the result page after a code; /verify doesn't say you can check a PDF.
findings.fix: Offer 'Check a PDF' on /verify and read the code from the file.

findings.what: A venture handed to a teammate shows them as 'Creator' on their CV.
findings.repro: Transfer ownership, issue the new owner's CV.
findings.fix: Keep 'Creator' for the founder; show 'Owner' or 'Lead' for later owners.

findings.what: 'A quiet week… no upcoming events' while the Events card lists 4 upcoming events; the page is rebuilt only nightly.
findings.repro: Open This week the day events are published.
findings.fix: Build it live, or say 'updated nightly' and link to Events.

findings.what: Follow, Join and Ask to join give no confirmation; '1 members'.
findings.fix: Toasts ('You joined…'); singular 'member'.

findings.what: Being accepted in an induction round produced no notification.
findings.fix: Notify the applicant on every decision.

findings.what: The list shows '50 seats left' for an event whose registration is closed (and later cancelled), and '20 seats left' for a batch-only event the student can't join.
findings.fix: Show 'Registration closed', 'Cancelled', 'For 2027 only' on the card.

findings.what: After sending event feedback the page shows no thank-you or saved state.
findings.fix: 'Thanks: the society sees the totals.'

findings.what: A team captain can cancel with a plain browser confirm that says nothing about their team.
findings.fix: Say what happens to the team (members kept, new captain).

findings.what: The optional logo accepts any file and fails only after the request is sent ('the logo didn't upload').
findings.repro: Pick a PDF as the logo.
findings.fix: Check type on choosing.

findings.what: No notification for 'more information needed', approval or rejection of a society request.
findings.fix: Notify the requester of each decision.

findings.what: Term dates default to today and one year on, not the academic year.
findings.fix: Default to the university's academic year (Sept–June).

findings.what: Offering the presidency hands it over (once accepted) with no confirmation; the outgoing president loses the manage page and can't confirm their own term.
findings.fix: Confirm with what you lose; confirm your officers' terms first.

findings.what: Decline is instant with no note; Accept has no confirm; the shortlist state isn't kept visible.
findings.fix: Optional kind note on decline; confirm both.

plan_fixes.change: Google OAuth isn't configured locally; run T003 on staging with a university Google Workspace test account.
Needs a staging GitHub App and running workers; the local stack can't reach github.com and Edge Functions don't boot in the cloud container.
The claim email needs the notify worker; locally use the welcome screen's claim card, or run on staging.
Use 'password123' (10+ characters, breached) to test the breached-password check; 'password1' only tests length.
Ask about L1/L2 only of testers who connected GitHub; without it the step shows no levels.
Name pages that have first-visit tips: Openings, a venture page, CV, score, Privacy centre.
The product now offers 'Hide until tomorrow', not 'Hide checklist'; update F04.07a and the task ('hide your progress for today; find where it went').
Setup must include posts older than 2 hours (seed stage) or the tester sees almost none; the seed script ages them.
The product locks answers after 10 minutes, not 15; say 'come back after 10 minutes' or 'later'.
Mute and the report target are the same helper in practice; say 'report first, then mute', or use a different person to mute.
Say which text-size setting (browser font size vs Android font scale); they behave differently.
Helpers must open the post in the app before answering (questions are assigned on view); and the free public line needs 3+ positive answers.

A helper can't share a post the tester can't see; make the second post university-only at the tester's university and then change the tester's view (e.g. the author deletes it) to test the unavailable card.
Say 'remove the big photo after you've seen what happens' so the post has one photo.
Run on a real phone (Android Chrome install prompt; iOS Share > Add to Home Screen); headless browsers can't.
Name the stranger to find ('find Danish Helper in Explore'); filters alone return nobody.
The plan expects a notification of acceptance (T048); check it on the bell; in this run the venture page changed first.
Push needs VAPID keys and the notify worker; run on staging and a real phone.
The product can't sign out 'everywhere except this phone'; reword to 'sign out of all devices' or wait for the feature.
Removal and restriction are two decisions, each with its own appeal; say 'appeal one of them'.
Same tester opts out of leaderboards (T062) before T079; run T079 first or reset the opt-out.
The GitHub check and peer routing are worker/cron driven; locally the wait is simulated, on staging allow the github_wait_minutes.
On the free plan CV changes apply at the next monthly refresh; the done-when can't be met in a session. Use a Pro trial or accept 'saved for the next version'.
Setup: the genuine PDF needs Pro (trial); the forged one is a print with one character changed.
Use a tester who hasn't created ventures that day (daily create limit).
Reminders need the notify worker (staging); the check-in is S11's officer role.
'Confirm your officers' terms, then hand over' isn't possible in that order: terms end at handover and the next President confirms them; reword.
'This academic year' needs a Sept–June default; tell testers to type the dates.
